title: DCU Member Liga Firestore Data Structure
description: Reference schema for Firestore collections and document shapes. This is a structural guide, not a strict validator of all production variants.

categoryTransfers.description: Admin moves of a rider from one liga division to another. Each applied move appends last-place credits; it does not rewrite the division the rider left.

campaign_content.description: Short-lived HTML documents fetched by Zoho Campaigns while an admin mailing is created. The document id is an unguessable token. Deleted after Campaigns imports the HTML.

clubApiClients.description: One API login per club. Document id is the username. The secret is stored only as a PBKDF2-SHA256 hash.

league.description: Singleton docs: settings, standings (wrapper), liveOverlay, adminSettings

stageRaces.description: Season events (tours / monuments / classics). Stages are races linked via stageRaceId.

liveRaceState.description: Singleton-style collection; document id 'active' points at the race shown on /live-race.

posts.description: Nyheder blog posts. Comments live at posts/{postId}/comments.

strava_power_curves.description: Cached Strava peak-power curves per rider and window. Doc id {userDocId}_{days}. Reused for 24 h by the admin predictor; tuning reads the cache only and never calls Strava. Filled for tuning-eligible riders by POST /admin/predictor/strava-cache/warm (up to 10 riders per call, every 20 min via strava-cache-warm.yml or Fill now, paused while Strava read usage is above 75% of either limit); curves older than 30 days are refetched.

predictor_settings.description: Admin-only (default-deny in firestore.rules; backend Admin SDK only). Single doc 'current' with the active vELO predictor config, its metrics and change history. Kept out of the public league/settings because history names the admin who made each change.

strava_cache_warm.description: Admin-only. Single doc 'last': counts from the most recent Strava cache warm-up call, shown on the Tuning panel.

warmed.description: Riders whose curve now has power data

rateLimited.description: Stopped because the Strava budget (75% of the read limits) was reached

strava_rate_usage.description: Admin-only. Single doc 'current': the latest app-wide Strava read limits and usage from Strava's X-ReadRateLimit-* headers, plus the app's own count of Strava requests (the header undercounts), shared between function instances. Usage = max(header, own count); the Strava cache warm-up keeps it under 75% of both limits.

usage15.description: Reads in the 15-minute window containing 'at', as reported by Strava (the background budget uses this)

usageDay.description: Reads on the UTC day containing 'at', as reported by Strava (the background budget uses this)

ownCountDay.description: Strava requests the app made on ownDay (every function instance adds its own; informational)

ownQuarter.description: UTC quarter hour of ownCount15, e.g. 2026-11-03T19:2 (minutes 30-44)

ownCount15.description: Strava requests the app made in ownQuarter

predictor_research_runs.description: Admin-only. Claude code-execution sandbox research on anonymized tuning data (queued -> running -> done|failed|timed_out). Processed by POST /admin/predictor/research/process via predictor-research.yml. Proposed code is never run in production.

strava_cache_warm_lock.description: Admin-only. Single doc 'current' {owner, at} created atomically while a Strava cache warm-up runs, so overlapping calls (Cloud Scheduler, manual workflow, Fill now) never double Strava reads. Taken over after 16 minutes.

predictor_research_lock.description: Admin-only. Single doc 'current' {owner, at} created atomically while a research run is processed, so two workers never run (and bill) the same run. Taken over after 20 minutes.

predictor_tuning_runs.description: vELO predictor tuning runs. A run that finds better settings is pending until an admin applies or rejects it.

division_proposals.description: Admin-only. Division agent proposals for riders with no vELO or few Zwift rides. Nothing is applied until an admin approves (predict-assign / manual-assign, or a category transfer for locked riders), edits or rejects. A newer proposal supersedes an older pending one for the same rider.

name.description: For the admin page only; never sent to Claude

proposedCategory.description: null = not enough data; an admin places the rider by hand

suggestedCategory.description: Deterministic suggestion from the vELO predictor

flags.description: few_strava_rides, implausible_wkg, no_weight, strava_zwift_disagree, no_power_data, assessment_disagrees

evidence.description: Anonymized evidence (ratings, ride counts, Zwift/Strava predictions and inputs, flags, division list); no names or IDs

movePreview.description: Dry-run category transfer preview for locked riders

evidenceFingerprint.description: Hash of vELO, Zwift ride count and Strava curve time (not the current division). A decided proposal is not repeated, and a pending one is not rebuilt, until this changes

division_agent_queue.description: Admin-only. Riders waiting for the division agent (doc id = zwiftId). Filled by registration, Strava connect, the nightly ZR refresh and Scan riders now; processed by the predictor worker.

notBefore.description: Retry time, e.g. while the Strava budget is used up

division_agent_status.description: Admin-only. Single doc 'last': counts from the latest division agent batch.

streamRiders.description: League-wide Zwift-only dummy accounts for streaming. One roster is registered on every current and upcoming race. Not liga users or race signups.

drVerificationCount.description: Number of nested race subcollection docs copied (today: races/{id}/dr_verifications). Archived at archives/{id}/races/{raceId}/dr_verifications/{zwiftId}.

stageRaceCount.description: Number of stageRaces docs copied to archives/{id}/stageRaces/{eventId}

standings.description: Category-keyed standings map (inner map only; not the league/standings wrapper)

sprintPoints.description: Season sum of sprint-classified banner points in this division

komPoints.description: Season sum of climb-classified banner points in this division

bestRacesCount.description: Legacy flat-league best-X only; event GC uses stageRaces.bestRacesCount

seasonBestResultsCount.description: Season prestige best-X lines; 0/omit = count all

gracePeriod.description: Points above category upper boundary before status becomes over

weightVerificationValidDays.description: Approved weigh-in remains valid this many days from weighInDate; default 30

predictorFeatures.description: Legacy vELO predictor feature map (featureKey -> enabled). Read-only fallback before predictor_settings/current exists; no longer written.

divisionAgent.description: Division agent settings. minZwiftRides: riders with fewer Zwift rides in the CP window are not trusted as vELO ground truth and are reviewed by the agent.

tuneModel.description: Claude model for predictor sandbox research

enabled.description: false stops the division agent (no scans, no reviews)

assessModel.description: Claude model that writes division proposal texts

ligaCategories.description: Ordered liga category definitions (top category first, upper=null)

requiresVerification.description: When true, riders in this category are in scope for weight verification sampling and dual-recording reports

color.description: Badge hex color (#RRGGBB) for this liga category on Deltagere and related UI

defaultEventMode.description: Season default race eventMode; cloned into new races only

defaultSingleCategories.description: Template for single-mode categories (no eventId); cloned into new races

defaultEventConfiguration.description: Template for multi-mode category rows (eventId filled per race)

defaultRaceGroups.description: Template for grouped mode (eventId filled per race)

jerseyUnlocks.description: Curated catalog jerseys with drop-level auto-grant and/or promo code

clubKits.description: One assigned in-game jersey per DCU club (pinned or auto)

classificationJerseys.description: Zwift jerseys worn by the individual, sprint, and KOM leaders

lastBannerPoints.description: Points on the last sprint or KOM banner of this race, used to break season ties

leagueAdminSettingsDoc.description: Singleton at league/adminSettings — experimental power-analysis thresholds

bestRacesCount.description: Per-event GC best-X (e.g. 1 of 1, or 4 of 5)

postDoc.description: Nyheder post at posts/{postId}. Comments are posts/{postId}/comments.

coverPositionX.description: Horizontal crop anchor for the news card, 0-100. 50 is center. Omitted posts stay centered.

coverPositionY.description: Vertical crop anchor for the news card, 0-100. 0 shows the top of the photo.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created or last saved the post

authorName.description: Byline shown on Nyheder; may be a participant name when posting on someone else's behalf

authorZwiftId.description: Zwift ID when the byline is a participant; null when the byline is the signed-in poster

map.description: Zwift world name. Empty or omitted when world is TBD.

routeId.description: Zwift route signature. Empty or omitted when route is TBD.

routeName.description: Display route name. Empty or omitted when route is TBD.

preRegisterAllowed.description: When true, riders may Tilmeld before a Zwift eventId exists. Omitted or false means wait for løbspas unless an event is already configured.

stageRaceId.description: Parent stageRaces/{id} when this race is a stage of a season event

resultsSource.description: Set to 'seed' when results were written by admin Testing. Cleared with seeded results. Does not mark users as test accounts.

club.description: DCU club snapshot copied from the user profile at scoring

categoryTransfer.description: True when this row is a last-place credit from a category move, not a finish the rider rode in this division.

finishAudit.description: Derived finish vs official GET /api/link/race-results/subgroups/{subgroupId}. Audit only; does not change scored finishTime.

veloChanges.description: Per-rider vELO before/after from ZwiftRacing GET /public/results/{eventId}. Written by POST /races/{raceId}/velo-changes/refresh (admin).

threshold.description: Points; a rider is flagged when delta > threshold and after > graceLimit

category.description: Liga category the rider was scored in

graceLimit.description: Category upper boundary + gracePeriod; null for top category

zwiftUserId.description: Zwift public UUID used by batch-register

ligaCategory.description: Snapshot of effective liga category at last write/sync

streamRiderDoc.description: Stored at streamRiders/{zwiftId}. Zwift pen registration for every current and upcoming race.

_id.description: Numeric Zwift profile id or public UUID

publicId.description: Zwift public UUID used by batch-register

category.description: Liga category whose Zwift pen this rider is registered on

raceCount.description: Races that had a pen to register (skipped races with no event are excluded)

registrations.description: Per-race pen result, keyed by race id

source.description: mandatory if verification category and trainer requires DR; otherwise opt_in

likelyRaceId.description: Firestore race document ID if this activity was matched to a league race

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the stored Strava access token expires

access_token.description: Current Strava access token. Other instances reuse it instead of rotating the refresh token.

refresh_lock_until.description: Unix seconds. While this is in the future, one instance is refreshing the service token.

dualRecordingOptIn.description: When true, rider is included in dual-recording checks even without a mandatory trainer/category

male.description: Zwift racing-profile male flag. false means the rider is a woman.

achievementLevel.description: Raw Zwift achievementLevel from racing-profile or unofficial JSON profile

dropLevel.description: Zwift drop level used for kit auto-grants

gameClientUserAgent.description: Last Zwift game userAgent (platform of last launch)

gameClientPlatform.description: Parsed last game client. P-codes can only be typed on windows/mac.

canEnterUnlockCode.description: True when last game client is Windows or Mac

manualAssigned.description: Admin/predictor hold that nightly auto-assign will not replace until released.

weighInDate.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD of the weigh-in

source.description: sampled if admin-triggered; voluntary if rider-initiated. Missing source = sampled

weighInDate.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD of the weigh-in

source.description: sampled if admin-triggered; voluntary if rider-initiated. Missing source = sampled

_id.description: Document id; use 'active' for the single live-race pointer.

raceId.description: Firestore races/{raceId} shown on /live-race; null when deactivated.

activatedBy.description: Firebase Auth uid of admin who activated, or 'auto' / 'season_reset'.

manualDisabled.description: When true and raceId is empty, auto-activation is skipped for races whose live window already started at activatedAt. A later race (window start after activatedAt) still auto-activates.

predictorConfig.description: vELO predictor settings (backend/services/velo_predictor.py PredictorConfig), stored at predictor_settings/current.config. The admin predictor page, division agent and tuning all use this one config.

features.description: featureKey -> enabled (weight_kg, zrs, wkg5s, wkg1m, wkg5m, wkg20m, watts*, compound*)

ridgeLambda.description: Ridge strength on standardized features, scaled by row count

stravaPowerScale.description: Multiplier per W/kg input applied to Strava (outdoor) power before predicting; 1.0 = no correction. Range 0.5-1.5.

minStravaActivities.description: Fewer Strava rides than this marks a Strava prediction low-confidence

trainingMinRides.description: Train only on riders with a reliable vELO (at least this many Zwift rides in 90 days and a stable rating); 0 = every rider with a vELO. Tuning tries 0 and minZwiftRides.

history.description: Earlier predictor configs, newest first (max 20), so a change can be rolled back from the admin predictor page.

metrics.description: metrics at the time the config was replaced
Cross-validated Strava-to-division accuracy of the active config, from the tuning run that produced it. Null after a manual save.

divisionAccuracy.description: Percent of eval riders predicted into their real division

windows.description: On the longest window's doc: every window (e.g. 30, 60, 90) written by the same fetch; the warm-up refetches curves missing a tuning window

curve.description: Peak watts keyed w{seconds}: w5, w15, w30, w60, w120, w300, w1200 (best of indoor and outdoor)

curveIndoor.description: Peak watts from indoor rides only (Strava VirtualRide, e.g. Zwift, or trainer rides)

curveOutdoor.description: Peak watts from outdoor rides only; the predictor applies the outdoor->indoor correction to these

split.description: True when curveIndoor/curveOutdoor exist; older entries are re-fetched

startedBy.description: Admin email/uid, or 'schedule' for the monthly run

baseline.description: Our own cross-validated score of the active config (n, divisionAccuracy, adjacentAccuracy, maeVelo, zwiftDivisionAccuracy)

idMap.description: Salted rider hash -> zwiftId. Private: never sent to Anthropic, stripped from API responses.

baselineReproduced.description: Claude's baseline accuracy within 1 pp of ours

status.description: running until POST /admin/predictor/tune/<runId>/process (admin page) or POST /admin/predictor/worker (Cloud Scheduler, every 5 min) computes it

processingStartedAt.description: Set once, in a transaction, by whichever caller claims the run; it is never processed twice

result.description: status (insufficient_data|no_improvement|improved), evalRiders, current/best {config?, fitScale, score}, improvementPP, changedRiders [{zwiftId, realCategory, before, after}], pastPredictions, windowsAvailable, message

_id.description: Unguessable URL token. Not a rider or campaign id.

clubApiClientDoc.description: Stored at clubApiClients/{username}. Username is lowercase and has no colon. secretHash is PBKDF2-SHA256 of the secret; the plaintext secret is never stored.

club.description: Club name as stored on rider profiles

clubKey.description: Casefolded club name, used so a club has only one client

lastUsedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last successful API call, or null before the first call

requestTimes.description: ISO timestamps of calls inside the current 60-second limit. Older entries are dropped. The 61st call in that minute is rejected.
